# Owner: Antony Loose

## Identity
Antony Loose is a Melbourne-based Software Engineer with ~3 years of professional experience across full-stack web development and full-stack Android development.

He currently works:
- At Monash University, building software for academic and research teams.
- At Hailo, as a full-stack Android engineer delivering production features and client-facing technical demos.

## Core Strengths
- Strong end-to-end ownership: requirements -> design -> implementation -> delivery
- Full-stack mindset with attention to correctness, simplicity, and maintainability
- Comfortable working independently or in small, high-responsibility teams
- Experience presenting and demoing technical work to major clients

## Technical Focus
Primary areas of expertise:
- TypeScript (vanilla web, tooling, package development)
- Android development (Kotlin, Android platform)
- Node.js and backend services
- Modern frontend development (React, React Native)
- Linux servers, Nginx, AWS
- 3D / graphics work (Three.js)
- Infrastructure and deployment fundamentals

Antony values:
- Simple, explicit abstractions
- High-quality code over premature complexity
- Purpose-driven software with real-world impact

## Interests & Motivation
Antony is particularly motivated by:
- Package and library development (especially npm ecosystem)
- Accessibility and assistive technology
- Socially impactful software
- Thoughtful engineering that prioritizes users over hype

A representative project is “Auslan Spell”, an accessibility-focused web application.
